author: SnakePlisken478
quote: I was 12 and saved all my paperboy money and whatever I made at stacking shelves to buy this and an N64. I now played with my Son 28 years later. I have no words to describe what happened this week. Other than Thank You Nintendo. I am blessed to see my boys face full of happiness. I can't wait for him to play when he's 40 on his 40th edition I am time capsuling for him.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: SnakePlisken478
quote: Tough day at work. John was a jerk to me today. Wife's chores done, kids classes done, homework help completed, fixed the toilet, changed a light bulb on the truck, paid some bills, made a decaff coffee for my evening escape on GTA. I want my money back! This was supposed to be our escape, a guys area, just to switch for 1-2 hours and let loose, before our lives start tomorrow and you ruined it. Seriously why, like what logical reason is there? Pre-oder no physical copy and you supply us with being like my neighbour, a complete no personality door mat. At least Jim (neighbour) makes me laugh. God damn it Rockstar!
